classification.difficultyReason: Reverse sector problems with a reflex interior angle, including converting the exterior 70° in part a and finding the diameter in b.

content.prompt: Find the unknown value in each sector.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
The area is $180\text{ m}^2$.
Find the radius to 2 d.p.

answer.worked:
The $70^\circ$ angle is outside the sector, so $\theta=360^\circ-70^\circ=290^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{\theta}{360}\pi r^2\\180&=\frac{290}{360}\pi r^2\\64800&=290\pi r^2\\\frac{6480}{29\pi}&=r^2\\r&=\sqrt{\frac{6480}{29\pi}}\\r&\approx8.43\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
